_note: LOOTABLE turn-ins only. The guide's other paths (Red Wine, Muffin, Bandages, Bat Wing, Grub Locker, Lion Meat Shipment) are vendor purchases or quest hand-outs — they never appear in a loot line, so they cannot fire a loot alert and are deliberately absent. Curated by hand: the page is freeform prose and a regex over it produced one usable row out of a known nine.
